messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

Thanks. Yes, I want a fair financial share, and I won’t subsidize A’s discounted purchase. I haven’t agreed to it. I don’t know what B wants, and A knows I’m not on board. I’d like us to settle it fairly, but there’s no rush.
I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount. I’m worried we won’t be able to move forward unless C agrees, and she hasn’t yet. The price and shares still need to be worked out.
I’d like my share of the money, if that’s possible, to help me start a dance studio. I’m not sure what the house or our shares are worth yet.
Yes, broadly. The discount matters because it would make buying the house more financially manageable for us and help me build some independence. I can’t say yet what price would be fair.
Yes, that’s about right—I’d like my share to reflect what the house is actually worth. I’m not sure how soon I’d need the money, so I don’t think we need to rush.

My part is right. I can’t confirm B’s priorities for her. An independent appraisal makes sense; I’d consider payments over time only if I still receive my full fair share. I’m not agreeing to a sale yet.

Payments over time could help, but a full appraisal-based price without a discount may still be unaffordable for us. I can’t agree to terms yet. Also, I only know B wants money; I don’t know what for.
That sounds right to me. An independent appraisal and payments over time could work, as long as my share is based on the agreed value. I’m not sure what timing or payment terms would suit.
Yes, potentially—if the full appraised value is paid with fair interest and the payment terms are secure and agreed. I’m not agreeing to specific terms yet.

I’m not sure yet. A longer schedule could help, but affordability depends on the appraisal, interest and payment terms, and our finances. I’d need to discuss those with my husband before agreeing; knowing B’s goal doesn’t settle that.
